text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Well then... I'm off.

"...I'm sorry I couldn't keep up with 
you."
choice_data_list: (...What? ...Is this... me?)
(…Huh? …What is this… Is that… me?)

text_block_list.name: Race Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Chrono Genesis finishes in 7th place...! 
Once again, the world stage proves to be a 
high wall for Japan's Umamusume, but—
choice_data_list: （……なんだ？……これは……俺？）

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—I awoke to find my back sticky with cold 
sweat. The sight of her back viewed 
through the screen was burned into the 
back of my eyelids.
choice_data_list: （――違う！俺は一緒にフランスに……！）
（――違う！私は一緒にフランスに……！）
choice_data_list_en: (—No! I want to go to France with you...!)
(—No! I want to go to France with you...!)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah... good morning, Trainer-san. ...You 
look somewhat sleepy, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't possibly tell her, with her big 
race right around the corner, that I woke 
up feeling awful just from a bad dream.
choice_data_list: な、何でもないよ

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Ah... yes. Understood.
choice_data_list: 今日は休養日だ。コンディション維持優先で
今日は休養日。コンディション維持優先で
choice_data_list_en: Today is a rest day. Make maintaining your condition the priority.
Today is a rest day. Prioritize maintaining your condition.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
You'll need a way to refresh yourself 
before the big stage. A leisurely stroll 
through Paris should put you in the right 
frame of mind.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...What a beautiful town...
choice_data_list: Um... Aren't you gonna go out or anything?
Um... Aren't you going out or anything?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ah... This is my father's birthplace. 
It's a bit far away, so... for now, I'll 
have to settle for just the video.
choice_data_list: ええと……出かけたりしないのか？
ええと……出かけたりしないの？
choice_data_list_en: Uhm... are you not going out?
Uhm... are you not going out?

text_block_list.name: Loves's Stream
text_block_list.text:
"Love me♡ Love you♡ It's Loves Only You~♡ 
Today, I'm connected with Chrono-chan in 
France♪"
choice_data_list: そ、そう……

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
H-Hello there... Um, it's just before noon 
here in France—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Mumu... According to Trainer's prediction, 
Umamusume No. 3 will take the lead. But 
taking distance aptitudes into account, 
No. 8's late charge should reach in time.
choice_data_list:
Let's see whose analysis hits closer to 
the mark.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Ah. Before I knew it, it got this 
late...
choice_data_list: どちらの分析が的を射ているか、勝負だね
choice_data_list_en: Let's see whose analysis hits the mark—it's a contest!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... Since you said, "prioritizing 
condition maintenance"...
choice_data_list: せっかくのパリなのに宿にいてよかったの？
choice_data_list_en: We came all the way to Paris, were you really fine just staying at the hotel?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
You could say... this happened because I 
tried to do the thing that would calm me 
down the most right now...
choice_data_list:
I don't mind, but wouldn't that just be 
the same as usual?

I'm fine with it, but wouldn't it be no 
different from usual?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Still... well, before leaving Japan, 
Trainer, you also—
choice_data_list: 俺はいいけど普段と代わり映えしなくない？
私はいいけど普段と代わり映えしなくない？
choice_data_list_en: I'm fine with it, but isn't that just the same old thing?
I'm fine with that, but won't it feel like any other day?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you going to do any special 
training over there? I thought the 
schedule would push you to the very 
brink...
choice_data_list:
I've already built up everything I need, 
you know.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Building it up...
choice_data_list: 必要なことは全部、積み重ねてきたからね
choice_data_list_en: We've built up everything we need, after all.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
So when told to rest... maybe they just 
felt like doing what's 'normal'...?
choice_data_list: それを信じて、いつも通りにいこう！
choice_data_list_en: Have faith in that, and let's go out there just like always!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Spending "ordinary time" with those close 
to me... right now, feels like it's giving 
me strength.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
In that sense... I think today was a very 
good rest day...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Besides—I want to save sightseeing for 
later. After... w-w... winning the Prix de 
l'Arc de Triomphe!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Like touring famous racecourse sights, or 
going on a foodie tour around the track...
choice_data_list: —Right, that's true!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The unpleasant lingering feeling from the 
nightmare had faded. I felt saved by her 
smile.
choice_data_list: ――そう、そうだね！

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Let us go... and carve our names into 
history.
choice_data_list: 一緒に積み重ねてきたものの力を証明しよう
choice_data_list_en: Let's prove the power of everything we've built up together.
